integrity: The one-update condition and two-update bound are proved from the source iteration equations and replayed by exact rational arithmetic.
The source paper and its appendix were inspected at the theorem and proof passages relevant to the initialization issue.
No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact-arithmetic result for the split l2-regularized quadratic and the source paper's over-relaxed update convention only.
Does not cover inexact subproblem solves, changing penalties, inequality-constrained ADMM, or floating-point finite termination.
An unindexed erratum or informal note could still contain the same initialization correction.
title: Warm-start correction for one-step over-relaxed ADMM on regularized quadratics
